work.summary: Physical MAXQ Secret B No. 2 photobook featuring Korean fitness model and Instagram influencer Choi Sohyeon (최소현). Spomax's product page gives the exact title; a Spomax-attributed Gmarket listing provides the 2022-12-23 publication date, 116 pages, and 220 × 285 mm dimensions. Sports Seoul's release coverage corroborates the December 23 date. No ISBN was verified. No cover image was copied because reuse permission is unconfirmed.

edition.contentSummary: The Spomax-attributed Gmarket product record lists this one-volume print photobook as 116 pages, 220 × 285 mm, published 2022-12-23 by MAXQ International. Sports Seoul reported the No. 2 release date as December 23. No ISBN is shown in the reviewed sources. Bibliographic metadata only; no listing price or cover asset is stored.
